calls.interpretation: Untextured hull has UV/material blockers. Any source score is readiness only, not fidelity or production grade.

required_preservation_checks: uploaded artifact bytes equal normalized source GLB SHA256
export assets/model.glb bytes equal uploaded source GLB SHA256
FBX export exists and passes independent Blender re-import inspection; Apollo's export QA does not roundtrip FBX
If later uploading a rigged/textured GLB, inspect joints, weights, skins, animations, and textures in both GLB and exported FBX
Keep the hull report with final evidence because upload nodes record provider_id=upload rather than the direct hull adapter run
critical_limits: Do not use compile goal auto/deliver/character on a rigged or reference-textured upload: unconditional xatlas UV and procedural texture stages strip appearance and skin/animation data through trimesh processing.
Do not run repair-until-quality or generic next action automatically on a rigged candidate: mesh repair/UV/texture functions are static-mesh operations.
preset unreal avoids the optional web optimizer and preserves original GLB bytes; FBX conversion imports the original GLB in Blender directly.
export_pack uses the newest succeeded mesh/texture/UV node, not the promoted node. Export from a fresh task asset with only the intended upload, or confirm the latest source before exporting.
Back references only support appearance and QA; the Apollo hull geometry used front and side.
Apollo upload readiness score 1.0 and export file checksum success do not establish visual fidelity or game-ready deformation.
